caption: The drawing features a single square piece of woven textile positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The textile itself is illustrated in muted earth tones, including shades of brown, tan, yellow, and faint reddish hues. The surface of the textile is decorated with a repeating pattern of zigzag or chevron lines, closely arranged in parallel rows that alternate directions, creating a sense of movement across the fabric. The lines within the pattern are formed by groups of short, straight marks in the various shades mentioned, contributing to a rich, textured appearance. The edges of the textile appear slightly uneven, giving it a natural, handwoven look. The entire textile square is bordered faintly in blue and appears slightly raised against the flat background. No other objects or details are present in the composition.
